text.tspan: Labor force participation rate for women ages 15-24, 1980 vs. 2023
Share of the female working-age population aged 15-24 who are economically active (employed or
unemployed). Figures refer to national estimates and may not be fully comparable across countries.
Female labor force participation rate, ages 15-24 in 2023
Female labor force participation rate, ages 15-24 in 1980
Data source: Labour Force Statistics, via World Bank (2026)
Note: Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS and includes the production of goods for own use, such as subsistence farming. Where
data for 1980 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 1975 and 1985 is shown instead.
